question: In the coal oxidation study for coalbed methane, what specific surface area did sample LRC-XJ-A have before and after oxidation?
rendered: According to Table 4 in the document, sample LRC-XJ-A had a specific surface area (SSA) of 6.464 m2/g before the oxidation treatment (SSA-bot), and 1.264 m2/g after the oxidation treatment (SSA-aot).
